resources.string: Open and view documents, spreadsheets, slides and photos. Everything renders on your phone, nothing is uploaded.
PDF · Word (.docx) · Excel (.xlsx, .xls, .csv, .ods) · PowerPoint (.pptx) · Photos (JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, HEIC, SVG and more) · Text, Markdown, JSON and code files
Tip: in your file manager, tap any file and choose Open with > ViewAll.
